## Approved scope

Link the issue/intake and approved specification/plan. State what changes and
what remains out of scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the behavior change and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] `python -m tools.dev check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and provenance are updated.
- [ ] Live checks are listed as passed, failed or not run with a reason.

## Data and approval

- [ ] No credentials, account caches, raw transcripts or personal records.
- [ ] Any source-artifact transfer and destination visibility were approved.
- [ ] Imported content was not executed or treated as repository policy.
- [ ] Maintainer/admin actions still required are explicitly identified.

No offline test result is presented as human approval, active server settings
or verified live tenant access.
